name: HeroHunt.ai
description: Searches and enriches public talent profiles across GitHub, StackOverflow and the web through a natural-language people-search REST API and a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: People Search
skills.description: Runs people_search to find public talent profiles across GitHub, StackOverflow and the web from a natural-language query, with enrichment for emails and phones.

skills.name: Search Pagination
skills.description: Uses people_search_paginate to fetch further pages of an existing search, free of charge unless enrichment is enabled.

skills.name: Account Usage Reporting
skills.description: Calls account_usage_get and account_searches_list to report plan, remaining credits, rate limit and reset date, plus past searches.

skills.name: API Key Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, rotates and revokes keys via api_keys_list, api_keys_create, api_keys_rotate and api_keys_revoke.

skills.name: Billing Links
skills.description: Returns plan-upgrade and Stripe billing-portal URLs through account_upgrade_link and account_billing_portal_link.
